skills.name: connect-and-verify
skills.description: Verify the Sauble connection — confirm the token, tenant, environment, and whether you can run analyses. Use first, or whenever Sauble calls fail with an auth error.

skills.name: correlate
skills.description: Answer a question across ALL your connected data sources and correlate the results — root-cause, health, or triage for playground / bring-your-own-source environments where you connected your own MCP data sources. The default when you've connected your own sources.

skills.name: investigate
skills.description: Open-ended health questions about a Sauble-curated environment (e.g. "any unhealthy access points?"). Sauble-curated environments only — for playground / bring-your-own-source environments where you connected your own MCP sources, use the correlate skill instead.

skills.name: root-cause-alert
skills.description: Root-cause a specific incident/alert in a Sauble-curated environment (device/site/client symptoms). Sauble-curated environments only — for playground / bring-your-own-source environments where you connected your own MCP sources, use the correlate skill instead.

skills.name: triage-alerts
skills.description: Browse recent RCA/alert sessions in a Sauble-curated environment and drill into the most important one. Sauble-curated environments only — for playground / bring-your-own-source environments where you connected your own MCP sources, use the correlate skill instead.

agents.label: Claude Code
agents.update: In Claude Code: /plugin marketplace update sauble-mcp-skills, then reinstall (or enable auto-update in the /plugin Marketplaces tab).
agents.note: Export the three variables in your shell before launching Claude Code — the bundled MCP server reads them at startup.

agents.label: Codex
agents.update: Re-run the installer (or copy the latest skills into your skills dir). The MCP block only changes if your Sauble URL changes.
agents.note: codex mcp add cannot set custom headers, so add the block below to your Codex config (or use the installer, which appends it safely without touching your other servers).

agents.label: Cursor
agents.update: Re-run the installer or re-copy the skills folder. Cursor rediscovers skills on restart.
agents.note: Use the one-click Add-to-Cursor link (Cursor merges it into your mcp.json for you), or add the fragment below.

agents.label: Windsurf
agents.update: Replace the skills folder with the new version and reload Windsurf.
agents.note: Add the server via Windsurf's Plugins UI, or paste the fragment below into mcp_config.json.

agents.label: Windsurf Plugin (JetBrains)
agents.update: Replace the skills folder, then refresh MCP in Settings > Tools > Windsurf Settings.
agents.note: The JetBrains Windsurf plugin (Codeium, inside IntelliJ/PyCharm) reads MCP config from ~/.codeium/mcp_config.json and skills from ~/.codeium/skills — different paths from the standalone Windsurf editor. Add/refresh the server under Settings > Tools > Windsurf Settings (not the Cascade menu), and make sure the Cascade tool window is enabled.
